payload.evidence: The Housing Options Manager explained that the proposed changes had been subject to consultation. 72 responses had been received and were detailed in the report.
payload.explanation: The minutes show the consultation was in front of the committee, which is why this is not a blank. But nothing in them says the committee changed anything because of what people said: it suggested no changes to the proposals, and the one recommendation it did make, on the no-garden rule, is not attributed to the consultation anywhere in the record.
